tex_content.html:
Let $\de (t)$ be the surgery parameter from Section 6.5. There is a $T = T(a) < \infty $ so that whenever $t \ge T$, no point in any area-minimizing compressing disk $N_t\subset \hat W_t$ is in the center of a $10 \delta (t)$-neck.

Proof

\sketch Apply the preceding estimates and compactness argument to the stated hypotheses; the limiting or inductive construction has the required properties. The retained proof uses \cite{schoen}, \cite[Theorem 2]{schoenyau}.

□

Lemma
[existence for kappa solutions]
